// Classifier fixture, vitest: SELF-SKIP and its negatives. Read as text by the classifier suites under tests/.
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

describe("self-skip", () => {
  it.skip("publishes", () => {
    expect(publish()).toBe(true);
  });

  it.skipIf(!process.env.API_URL)("calls the API", async () => {
    expect(await call()).toBe(200);
  });

  it("is planned");

  it.todo("handles retries");

  it("reads the cache", (ctx) => {
    if (!redisUp) ctx.skip();
    expect(read()).toBe(1);
  });

  it("publishes when enabled", { skip: false }, () => {
    expect(publish()).toBe(true);
  });
});

describe.skip("legacy", () => {
  it("still works", () => {
    expect(legacy()).toBe(1);
  });
});

describe.todo("billing");
